note: One bundle, one column per group of old tests; the aliases are the cvids (scb:<cvid>) and the workbook rows. AmPolTyp (the workbook's Individ row 600, 1990-2024): cvid 1 is the 2020 anchor on VarId 31619, delivered twice (rows 2 and 3: the coalescing test's one record with both locators; the bundle has 9 rows, 6 of them AmPolTyp); cvids 2 and 3 are blanks on the anchor's VarId with an unparseable ('okänd utgåva') and a pooled (2020-2021) period, so neither is a target; cvid 4 is the exact spelling under an unparseable period (the incomplete-report test), and cvid 5 the spelling in 2025, after the workbook (a source-only observation). No variant-153 edition but 2020 and 2025 exists, so the unscoped witnesses leave edition presence unknown (the key is absent). OnlyScb (no workbook row): cvid 11 named in 2019, blanks 12 (unparseable) and 13 (pooled 2018-2019) on its VarId, as the old source-only test; the column-filter test's OnlyScb claims run on this column: no workbook record selected, the workbook's qualification context reported once on the report and never on a record, three outcomes of which one source-only. Inv_UtvGrEg5: the two year-independent declarations at Individ!42 and Individ årsoberoende!43, as the old test. The old tests ran the unparseable and pooled periods in separate bundles and claimed the report complete for a pooled one; here one report holds both, so each issue carries its own incomplete flag, and the claim that a pooled period alone leaves both reports complete is `a-pooled-period-alone-leaves-the-report-complete`. Each qualification context item appears exactly once on the report (`$once`), as the old test counted.
